name: Beta Hazard
detailed_description:
Beta Hazard is a third-person zombie shooting game that blends rich internet culture elements and humorous memes, providing a unique gaming experience. Players will face various enemies in a challenging and humorous environment while exploring the dark corners of New York City.

Story Background:
In modern New York City, a zombie virus known as the B-virus is quietly spreading. This virus originates from a notorious condom company, led by its chief scientist, Nanazi. As the virus spreads, the city quickly descends into chaos, with terrifying zombies and mutated creatures filling the streets. To save humanity's last stronghold, players will take on the role of Nana's ex-husband, Zhang Bing, and team up with a group of internet celebrities and phonebook heroes to uncover the company's and Lady Nana's conspiracy.

Gameplay:

  • Shooting Mechanics: Players will engage in combat from a third-person perspective, using various weapons to fight against enemies. Major enemies include:

    • Zombies: Ordinary shambling corpses that move slowly but come in large numbers.

    • Mutated Monsters: Enemies with special abilities that are fast and have strong attack power.

    • Armed Humans: Some survivors have been corrupted, turning into hostile forces that attack with firearms.

  • Puzzle Elements: In buildings overtaken by Nana's zombie army, players need to find clues and solve puzzles to discover escape routes. The game features complex environmental designs filled with hidden rooms and secret passages, testing players' observation skills and intelligence.

Game Atmosphere:
Despite having some horror elements, such as dark alleys and sudden zombie attacks, the overall atmosphere leans towards parody and humor. Players will encounter various funny dialogues and scenarios, with many scenes packed with internet culture memes, enhancing the game's fun and entertainment value.

Summary:
Beta Hazard is not just an exciting shooting game; it is a humorous and creative adventure journey. Players will experience a unique blend of thrill and laughter in a world surrounded by zombies and parody culture.
